hypotheses.sql: SELECT "Codice stabile", Nome, Stato FROM claims WHERE "Codice stabile" LIKE ? ORDER BY "Codice stabile"

critical_samples.sql: SELECT json_extract(Descrizione,'$.reference[1983]') AS reference_ma_cm2, json_extract(Descrizione,'$.imposed_seed17[1983]') AS imposed_ma_cm2, json_extract(Descrizione,'$.autonomous_seed17[1983]') AS autonomous_ma_cm2 FROM observations WHERE "Codice stabile"=?

diagnosis.sql: SELECT json_extract(Risultato,'$.factual_diagnosis') AS diagnosis,json_extract(Risultato,'$.threshold_samples[0].weak_peak_relative_error') AS weak_peak_relative_error,json_extract(Risultato,'$.official_task47_verdict_unchanged') AS original_verdict FROM findings WHERE "Codice stabile"=?

rows.diagnosis: Small real amplitude approximation at the final weak response crosses the global10% classification boundary. Global last-active-index then compares different response islands (198.3vs153.4ms), inflating that support difference into44.9ms of apparent offset error. The weak response peak is at198.3ms in both model and reference; not a44.9ms physical relaxation delay. Not solely floating-point rounding.
